Saba Karim joins us on Hits & Misses to review all the action from Day 3 of the 1st Test between India and New Zealand. From India's top four batters making 90-year SENA history and KL Rahul's calm technique to Devdutt Padikkal solving the No. 3 spot, Shubman Gill's overturned DRS call, and India's Day 4 declaration plan, catch the complete tactical breakdown.
